meta.coverage_note: Top-3 weights count distinct recorded articles in the Journal of Finance, Journal of Financial Economics, and Review of Financial Studies published in 2016–2025 by current verified finance faculty at each university. Divide the counts by ten to get articles per year. Publications may predate the author's current appointment. The comparison sample also includes schools in the top 50 of QS, THE, or U.S. News, including ties. Each comparison uses its own top 100 and normalizes to Wharton. Publication coverage varies by school. Schools with no recorded articles receive zero Top-3 weight. PhD origins are unrestricted. The contribution from self placements is capped at one-quarter of the total. Across displayed records, 3497 complete PhD records are supplied as verified among 4699 submitted faculty.
